description:
About our brand and products: Lumina Pro is where dream glam rooms come to life. We sell vanity desks, vanity sets with mirrors, Hollywood vanity mirrors, LED mirrors, vanity chairs, makeup organizers, and full glam room furniture. Our pieces come loaded with RGB lighting, Bluetooth, USB charging, and glass top storage. Styled in creator glam rooms with millions of followers and seen in beauty and home inspiration features.

What makes us different: We sell the whole room, not random pieces. Desks, mirrors, seating, lighting, and storage all designed to work together. That means bigger carts and bigger commissions for you. Add careful packaging, real customer support, and products that look stunning on camera, and you get a brand your audience will thank you for sharing.

How affiliates can earn: Earn 8-10% on every sale through your link or code. Our orders average $1,100, so one sale can mean around $110 in your pocket. Extended cookie window, so you still get paid when followers click now and buy later. Monthly payouts via PayPal or bank transfer. Top creators unlock gifted products and bonus rates.

How to promote us: Post where your audience lives. Vanity tours, room transformations, glam room reveals, unboxings, get ready with me videos, dorm and apartment glow ups. TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Pinterest, blogs, all of it works. We supply photos, videos, and trending hooks so you never start from scratch. Just share your link or code and let the glam sell itself.

Other information: We ship across the US. Buy now pay later available, which makes big glam purchases easy for your audience to say yes to. Questions or custom code requests? Email info@luminapro.co and a real human will reply. Apply now and let's build dream glam rooms together.
payout_period:
Payouts go out on the 1st of each month via bank transfer, covering all approved commissions from the previous month.

Heads up: commissions are approved after our 30 day return window closes. So a sale in early January gets approved in February
term_and_condition:
AFFILIATE PROGRAM TERMS & CONDITIONS

Welcome to the Lumina Pro Glam Squad! Before the glam begins, here's the fine print. Short version: play fair, promote honestly, get paid.

These terms apply to Lumina Pro ("we" or "merchant") and to you, the affiliate who refers customers to our products. By joining the Program, you agree to these Terms and Conditions. If you don't agree with everything here, you can't register or participate. Simple as that.

1. Approval and Rejection
We review every application and reserve the right to approve or reject any registration at our sole discretion. Rejections are final with no legal recourse. Don't take it personally, we just protect the squad.

2. Affiliate Links and Coupons
Your affiliate link is generated automatically, and you can also create links for specific products or collections. Last click wins: if a customer clicks someone else's link and then yours, the sale counts as yours.

You may or may not be assigned a coupon code. Details live in your Dashboard. If a customer uses both your link and your code, you earn one commission, not two. No assigned code? Then don't promote coupons.

Share your link anywhere: Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, YouTube, blogs, magazines, even old school print ads. Wherever your audience lives.

3. Commissions and Payment
Every purchase made through your link earns you a commission based on our commission structure. Commissions are calculated on product value only, not tax or shipping.

To get paid, add your payment details in Settings. The payment schedule is posted on the Affiliate Guide page. Commissions are only paid on completed transactions. We review every referral order under our fair use policy. Track your earnings in the Commission tab and payouts in the Payment tab. Orders that get refunded or charged back don't pay out.

4. Marketing Tools
We share banners, logos, and promo media in your Marketing Tool tab. Download them or grab the embed code and post away. Free content, zero effort.

5. Network
If the Network tab is active, you can invite others to join as your downline affiliates. When they make sales, you earn a network commission too (rates depend on our settings). Share your network link, and anyone who signs up through it joins your downline. Glam grows glam.

6. Cookies
We track referrals with cookies, so your people need cookies enabled for you to get credit. If someone blocks or clears cookies, we can't track them and can't pay you for their orders.

Your cookie window is listed on the registration form. Tracking starts the moment someone clicks your link or uses your code. Every order they place within that window earns you commission automatically, no second click needed.

7. Leaving the Program
Want out? Email info@luminapro.co and we'll remove you. No hard feelings.

Now go forward and refer!
You made it to the end. Legend. Revisit these terms anytime, and if you have questions, email info@luminapro.co. Happy earning!
